description: "Free and Impartial Thoughts on the Sovereignty of God, The Doctrines of Election, Reprobation, and Original Sin" is a philosophical and theological treatise written in the mid-18th century. This work critiques the prevailing doctrines of divine sovereignty related to election and condemnation within Christian theology, presenting the author’s impassioned arguments for a more compassionate understanding of God.
